text: You don't have to finish a lab in the room. You do have to finish it the same day, or it never reaches the chart.
Remember: before your day ends, open Waiting to run, and finish or explain every lab there.
Biscuit Chen's ear cytology is on the slide, but the family is ready to go. Open the form.
Write what you have so far.
Save, finish later keeps it, but it isn't on the chart yet.
Checkout still works. The family can pay and leave.
Waiting to run lists every lab ordered but not finished, for the whole practice, by day.
Pick a doctor here to see just theirs.
At eight in the evening, anything still waiting becomes a task for whoever charged it, like this one for Maple's skin cytology.
If a lab really wasn't run, open it, write not run and why in the comments, and save. Or remove the charge.
The most common mistake: Save, finish later, then forgetting it. Remember: before your day ends, open Waiting to run, and finish or explain every lab there.
